problem.observed_behavior: An approved execution request can be durably queued while immediate GitHub workflow dispatch is unavailable or fails.
problem.previous_ui_claim: The queue will execute it automatically within a few minutes.
problem.previous_failure_behavior: A transient dispatch failure returned HTTP 503 even though the request remained safely queued.
problem.scheduler_evidence: The existing five-minute GitHub schedule is the fallback, but recent scheduled deliveries were irregular and must not be presented as a fixed delay.

next_gate: Merge/CI and authenticated production UI readback. Immediate dispatch still requires the existing server-side GitHub token configuration; this change does not invent a second executor or credential path.
